Create task_root (priority 8), then the OSTM0 tick
Standby or full start (P2_0, key scan)
Standby: only the MAIN link, wake-up and GUI
Full start: every driver and task
Ends in gui_main_loop (33 ms slot 0)
On the '{' screen a key frame becomes E4
FIRMWARE UPDATE entry + power key: arm update mode
Pass the filtered frame on
Mailbox header: tag 0xAA, length
F0/F1: send at once, no ACK wait
Keep a copy for a resend
Wait for ACK: start the ACK timeout handler
ACK pending: park the frame, one slot per type
E0 keys park in a 10-entry ring
ACK pending: queue the encoder event
Queue full: sum the deltas, clamped to +-127
Send an E1 encoder frame now
ACK: stop the timeout, clear pending
Send the next parked frame, then a queued encoder
3 failures after a 0xDB hello: show the command in hex
3 failures: reset MAIN and the DISPLAY
NAK: resend the kept frame at once
Wait for RX data (2 ms while a frame is partial)
3 timeouts with a partial frame: NAK and resync
Table command: wait for n + 2 bytes, validate, ACK
0x06 from MAIN: the hello was acknowledged
Log the frame
Everything but 'D'/'E' goes to the dispatcher
'D'/'E': SD block write / read handled here
0x21: payload to 0x20450035
0x06: ACK
0x15: NAK
0x24: display settings from +0x98
2nd 0x60 with byte 0xB3 = 1 while off: power on (CAT PS1)
GUI snapshot of the frame (0x240 bytes)
Drive the MAIN reset and boot pins
